title: LIVE WAVE HEIGHT/PERIOD/DIRECTION
noaa_source: NOAA/NCEP Great Lakes Wave Unstructured v2.1 (GLWUv2.1, WAVEWATCH III) — HTSGW height + PERPW peak period + WVDIR direction, surface analysis (single cycle)
product_name: NOAA/NCEP Great Lakes Wave Unstructured v2.1 (GLWUv2.1, WAVEWATCH III) — HTSGW height + PERPW peak period + WVDIR direction, surface analysis (single cycle)
variable: HTSGW significant height (base color, ft) + PERPW peak period (white labels, s) + WVDIR travel arrows (FROM+180), all surface analysis step 0 from the SAME cycle file
units: ft base (display); s labels (source s); degrees arrows
spatial_resolution_source: ~2.5 km NCEP GLWU Lambert grid (581x361), single cycle
spatial_resolution_rendered: 1800x1175 canvas over lon [-93.0,-73.5], lat [40.5,49.5] (mean-value binning, no upsampling of source precision)
missing_data_treatment: only finite HTSGW admitted; off-water grid points and land outside the NOAA shoreline transparent; never zero-filled. Period/dir sampled only on water.
shoreline_mask: assets/great_lakes_watermask.png — shared NOAA medium-resolution shoreline water mask (nautical-chart compilation, mean-high-water datum; snapped + polygonized once, full vertex precision, antialiased). Overlay alpha is multiplied by this mask and edge RGB is bled into transparent pixels (anti-fringe for bilinear clients), so every product shares one shoreline.
attribution: Data: US NOAA. This project is not endorsed by NOAA. See DATA_SOURCES.md for exact products and endpoints.
legend_scale_html: Base color = wave height, exact bin colors (see table). Model height max this run: 8.5 ft. Arrows point where the waves travel (WVDIR + 180°). White halo numbers are the actual peak period at that spot (seconds between crests, e.g. 4.2s), drawn in the same style as the arrows and placed just above them; extra numbers mark spots where the period changes sharply even between arrows. Period max now 7.4s, mean travel 140° (SE). Significant height = average of highest third of waves.
label_style: white fill (255,255,255,245) + dark halo (20,20,20,235), same as direction arrows; every 2th arrow + extras at >= 0.5s change
folder_html:
LIVE WAVE HEIGHT/PERIOD/DIRECTION

Wave height color + actual peak-period numbers + travel arrows, all from one GLWU cycle.

Base color = wave height, exact bin colors (see table). Model height max this run: 8.5 ft. Arrows point where the waves travel (WVDIR + 180°). White halo numbers are the actual peak period at that spot (seconds between crests, e.g. 4.2s), drawn in the same style as the arrows and placed just above them; extra numbers mark spots where the period changes sharply even between arrows. Period max now 7.4s, mean travel 140° (SE). Significant height = average of highest third of waves.
